List of Razakars will be made shortly
2021-12-19T00:00:00+06:00 | Bss, Barguna
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/news/list-razakars-will-be-made-shortly-2920761

Liberation War Affairs Minister AKM Mozammel Haque yesterday said the  list of Razakars will be made shortly after the related law is enacted in parliament.

He said this while speaking as chief guest at a function organised  by the district administration at Barguna Circuit House ground on occasion of Victory Day and a reception for Bir freedom fighters yesterday morning.

The minister said that digital ID cards will be issued to freedom fighters by March 26 next year.

Barguna-1 MP Advocate Dhirendra Debnath Shambhu; Sultana Nadira,  MP for reserved women's seat; Barguna Deputy Commissioner (DC) Habibur  Rahman, among others, attended the event.
